name: What should I consider when choosing materials for an accessible bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing materials for an accessible bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing materials for an accessible bathroom, prioritize safety, durability, and ease of maintenance alongside aesthetic appeal. Non-slip flooring options, such as certain textured tiles, are crucial. Consider solid surfaces for countertops and shower surrounds for their seamless, easy-to-clean properties. Durable, water-resistant materials are essential to ensure longevity. AKN Design Group assists with material selection, guiding you toward options that meet accessibility requirements while aligning with a luxury aesthetic, ensuring a cohesive and high-performing space. Our expertise helps integrate these choices into a comprehensive design plan.
